item.title: ०१७ विभीषणेन रामदर्शनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Vibhishana together with four of his companions reach Rama’s place. Halting in the sky itself, Vibhishana asks Rama to give a refuge to him. Sugriva tells Rama that he cannot trust Vibhishana the demon. Then Rama asks for opinion of the leaders in his group. Angada, sharabha, Jambavan and Mainda expressed their apprehensions to accept Vibhishana. But Hanuman says that Vibhishana need not be doubted because he thinks that Vibhishana understands the merits in Rama and demerits in Ravana. Hanuman further adds that Vibhishana is approaching Rama for refuge because Vibhishana is desirous of obtaining the kingdom of demons. Hanuman requests Rama to take his final decision on the matter.

item.title: ०१८ विभीषणेन रामसैन्यप्रवेशेच्छानिवेदनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Hearing Hanuman’s words, Rama says that he cannot desert Vibhishana who is seeking a refuge in him. Initially Sugreeva disagrees with Rama’s opinion. But when Rama explains the different circumstances under which Vibhishana is acceptable, Sugreeva also agrees with that view. Finally Vibhishana joins as an associate in Rama’s side.

स्रोतः: valmikiramayan.net

item.title: ०१९ विभीषणस्य रामपादशरणगमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Descending from the sky, Vibhishana seeks refuge at the feet of Rama. On Rama’s enquiry, he explains about the strength of Ravana. Rama promises to kill Ravana and anoints Vibhishana. Rama sits on the sea -shore, seeking the help of the ocean god to yield a passage for his army to pass through and reach the city of Lanka.

item.title: ०२० रावणेन स्वामात्यशुकप्रेषणम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

As per the advice of Sardula, Ravana sends Shuka to Sugriva as an ambassador. The monkeys harass him, who came to their place as a spy. But because of Rama’s gracefulness, Shuka comes out of danger. Sugriva gives a fitting reply to Ravana’s message sent through Shuka. When monkeys again try to bind him and harass him, Rama prevents them from killing him.

item.title: ०२१ रामेण समुद्रक्रोधः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

The careless ocean did not appear in his personal form to Rama, even when it was requested to do so. Rama becomes angry at the ocean and looses fierce arrows, which cause a terror among the creatures inhabiting the sea.

स्रोतः: valmikiramayan.net

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका समुद्रके तटपर कुशा बिछाकर तीन दिनोंतक धरना देनेपर भी समुद्रके दर्शन न देनेसे कुपित हो उसे बाण मारकर विक्षुब्ध कर देना
विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः

ततः सागरवेलायां दर्भानास्तीर्य राघवः ।
अञ्जलिं प्राङ्मुखः कृत्वा प्रतिशिश्ये महोदधेः ॥ १ ॥

item.title: ०२२ सेतुबन्धनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

When Rama is about to release a missile presided over by Brahma from his bow, the sea-god appears in person before him with joined palms and advises him to get a bridge constructed by Nala across the ocean. The ocean god disappears after giving this advice to Rama. Nala accordingly constructs a bridge across the sea with the help of other monkeys.

item.title: ०२३ रामेण शकुनवर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Rama explains to Lakshmana the various portents, he observes around him, that signal a destructive war fare. He orders for formation of battalions in the army and surges forth together with the battalions towards Lanka.

स्रोतः: valmikiramayan.net

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका लक्ष्मणसे उत्पातसूचक लक्षणोंका वर्णन और लङ्कापर आक्रमण
विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः

निमित्तानि निमित्तज्ञो दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः ।
सौमित्रिं सम्परिष्वज्य इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ १ ॥

item.title: ०२४ रामेण शुकनिर्बन्धनाज्ञा
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Seeing Lanka and describing it, Rama instructs Lakshmana to draw up his army in battle array. Rama orders for release of Shuka who was captured by the army earlier. Shuka approaches Ravana and describes the strength of Rama’s side of the army. Ravana boasts himself of his own army’s strength.

स्रोतः: valmikiramayan.net

item.title: ०२५ शुकेन रावणाय रामसैन्यबलवर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

While Rama crossed over to the other shore of the sea, Ravana instructs his ministers, Suka and Sarana to enter the enemy’s army in disguise and to bring all the required information about them. When Suka and Sarana entered the enemy’s ranks, Vibhishana recognises and captures them. But Rama sets them free. Going back to Ravana, they explain the might strength of the enemy’s ranks and exhort him to restore Seetha to Rama.

item.title: ०२६ रावणस्य कपिनायकविवरणश्रवणेच्छा
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Hearing the submission of Sarana, Ravana climbs up the roof of his palace and sees the entire army of monkeys from there. Ravana enquires about the various monkey leaders and Sarana shows him Nila, Angada, Nala, Sweta, Kumuda, Rambha, Sarabha, Panasa, Vinata and Krathana the army-generals along with their distinguishing characterestics.

item.title: ०२७ शरणेन कपिसैन्यवर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Sharana continues to describe the individual strengths of the various commanders in the army of monkeys, mentioning their names one by one, in detail.

स्रोतः: valmikiramayan.net

भागसूचना
  1. वानरसेनाके प्रधान यूथपतियोंका परिचय
विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः

तांस्तु ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रेक्षमाणस्य यूथपान् ।
राघवार्थे पराक्रान्ता ये न रक्षन्ति जीवितम् ॥ १ ॥

सर्वाष् टीकाः
मूलम्

तांस्तु ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रेक्षमाणस्य यूथपान् ।
राघवार्थे पराक्रान्ता ये न रक्षन्ति जीवितम् ॥ १ ॥

item.title: ०२८ शुकेन शत्रुसङ्ख्यागणनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Shuka in his turn enumerates the enemies and completes the account given by Sarana.

स्रोतः: valmikiramayan.net

भागसूचना
  1. शुकके द्वारा सुग्रीवके मन्त्रियोंका, मैन्द और द्विविदका, हनुमान् का, श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण, विभीषण और सुग्रीवका परिचय देकर वानरसेनाकी संख्याका निरूपण करना
विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः

सारणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् ।
बलमादिश्य तत् सर्वं शुको वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ॥ १ ॥

सर्वाष् टीकाः
मूलम्

सारणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् ।
बलमादिश्य तत् सर्वं शुको वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ॥ १ ॥

item.title: ०२९ रावणेन शुक-सारणयोरुच्चाटनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Ravana reprimands Shuka and Sarana, asking them to leave the assembly. He again sends some spies to the place of Rama and Lakshmana. Those spies were got caught by Vibhishana and the monkeys start harassing them. But the compassionate Rama gets them released and the spies reach back Lanka.

स्रोतः: valmikiramayan.net

भागसूचना
  1. रावणका शुक और सारणको फटकारकर अपने दरबारसे निकाल देना, उसके भेजे हुए गुप्तचरोंका श्रीरामकी दयासे वानरोंके चंगुलसे छूटकर लङ्कामें आना
विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः

शुकेन तु समादिष्टान् दृष्ट्वा स हरियूथपान् ।
लक्ष्मणं च महावीर्यं भुजं रामस्य दक्षिणम् ॥ १ ॥
समीपस्थं च रामस्य भ्रातरं च विभीषणम् ।
सर्ववानरराजं च सुग्रीवं भीमविक्रमम् ॥ २ ॥
अङ्गदं चापि बलिनं वज्रहस्तात्मजात्मजम् ।
हनूमन्तं च विक्रान्तं जाम्बवन्तं च दुर्जयम् ॥ ३ ॥
सुषेणं कुमुदं नीलं नलं च प्लवगर्षभम् ।
गजं गवाक्षं शरभं मैन्दं च द्विविदं तथा ॥ ४ ॥

item.title: ०३० रावणेन शार्दूलप्रेषणम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Dispatched by the king Ravana to ascertain the strength of the army in the opposition-camp, Shardula the demon-spy acquaints his master with the important leaders of the monkeys.

स्रोतः: valmikiramayan.net

भागसूचना
  1. रावणके भेजे हुए गुप्तचरों एवं शार्दूलका उससे वानर-सेनाका समाचार बताना और मुख्य-मुख्य वीरोंका परिचय देना
विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः

ततस्तमक्षोभ्यबलं लङ्काधिपतये चराः ।
सुवेले राघवं शैले निविष्टं प्रत्यवेदयन् ॥ १ ॥
